title: Duplicate metrics can be returned from a single call to /_synapse/metrics
body:
Prometheus statistics contain duplicate entries, when doing a request for metrics:

This doesn't seem to have an impact on the metrics produced - prometheus handles these and removes the duplicates.

Current response from /_synapse/metrics includes the same entry repeated like so:
```
synapse_util_caches_cache:hits{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 743447
synapse_util_caches_cache:total{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 1126745
synapse_util_caches_cache:size{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 387
synapse_util_caches_cache:evicted_size{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 0
synapse_util_caches_cache:hits{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 743366
synapse_util_caches_cache:total{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 1126625
synapse_util_caches_cache:size{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 387
synapse_util_caches_cache:evicted_size{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 0
synapse_util_caches_cache:hits{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 743447
synapse_util_caches_cache:total{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 1126746
synapse_util_caches_cache:size{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 387
synapse_util_caches_cache:evicted_size{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 0
synapse_util_caches_cache:hits{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 683481
synapse_util_caches_cache:total{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 1045791
synapse_util_caches_cache:size{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 371
synapse_util_caches_cache:evicted_size{name="_matches_user_in_member_list"} 0
```
This is rejected by prometheus when scraping this endpoint, as these are simultaneous updates of the same metric.
```
time="2018-05-17T14:05:41Z" level=warning msg="Error on ingesting samples with different value but same timestamp" numDropped=47 source="scrape.go:537" 
```
It's safe, but very noisy in logs.

This affects the matrix.org homeserver
